text:
Deleting your account cancels your Plant Club subscription, and deletion can take up to 30 days to complete. There's no cancellation fee or minimum term.

If a box has already been billed (Plant Club is charged on the 25th of the previous month), it isn't refunded on cancellation and will still be sent. Since it's October 3rd, that likely includes this month's box, which ships in the first full week of the month.

To delete your account, go to "Account" > "Privacy", where you can also download your data first if you'd like a copy.
